info.name: OCI Managed Services for Mac Mac Order API

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the compartment in which to list resources.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description:
A filter to return only resources that match the given lifecycle state. The
state value is case-insensitive.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the given display name exactly.

params.name: id
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the MacOrder.

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a
paginated "List" call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the opc-next-page response header from the previous
"List" call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either ascending (`ASC`) or descending (`DESC`).

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The field to sort by. You can provide only one sort order. Default order for `timeCreated`
is descending. Default order for `displayName` is ascending.

params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the MacOrder.
